hebrewText: וַ/יַּשְׁקֵ֗ף עַל פְּנֵ֤י סְדֹם֙ וַ/עֲמֹרָ֔ה וְ/עַֽל כָּל פְּנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/כִּכָּ֑ר וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה עָלָה֙ קִיטֹ֣ר הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כְּ/קִיטֹ֖ר הַ/כִּבְשָֽׁן

tokens.bdb: properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle)
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin)
to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
